items.title: Jan van Eyck Academie Residency 2028
items.funding:
Fund: partial
Application fee: waived for India (LMIC on DAC list) or €65 excl. VAT / €78.65 incl. VAT
Programme fee: €2,750 excl. VAT enrolment fee
Travel: not stated
Stay: covered (furnished private studio apartment; rent deducted from stipend)
Living: covered (monthly stipend €1,500, or €2,000 with children; rent deducted)
You pay in total: €2,750 enrolment + travel (not stated)
items.eligibility:
Degree: no formal degree required (post-academic, open to artists/designers/curators/writers/architects/researchers)
Who can apply: individuals, duos, collectives, candidates with children; international
IELTS required/not required/not stated: not stated
NET required/not required/not stated: not stated
Language: English (sufficient for conversation and collaboration; Dutch also used)
Age: no age limit
items.verifyNote: Confirmed open on official site and e-flux; application fee waiver for LMIC including India; enrolment fee applies; stipend and housing provided.
